method: Complete code-behind read and pinned Git blob identity verification. XAML counterpart not yet credited.
findings: Editor mutates supplied HotKeyProfile object directly on events; it does not itself implement saved-state transaction. Enclosing ProfileManager controls clone/save boundary.
Numeric delay is cast double to int without explicit finite/range validation in this handler, linking earlier numeric-control boundary concerns to model. XAML admission limits still need reading.

new IsEnabled property hides inherited UIElement property and means checkbox state. Expanded fields are imperatively enabled; WPF dependency-property/binding semantics are not equivalent to this hidden CLR property.

Keybinding hooks start sequentially after notifying main hooks stopped. No try/finally rollback if keyboard/mouse hook construction or Start fails, and no Unloaded/IDisposable cleanup in this file. Normal cleanup occurs on hotkey field LostFocus.

Backspace clears HotKeys but leaves IsMouse/IsDoubleClick state intact and returns before setting event handled. Mouse click outside field posts focus removal asynchronously; later queued callbacks lack lifecycle guard.

Allowed keyboard combinations include modifier presence, F1-F23 and selected special keys; standalone F24 is absent. Mouse double-click uses fixed500ms same-key timing without position/system threshold and without explicit reset across editing sessions.

Scope change rebuilds allowed actions, preserving currently selected allowed action or first allowed; undefined scope falls into unrestricted enumeration. Imported enum validation remains a separate concern.
limits: No WPF or third-party hook execution, no claim of reproduced leak or key handling failure. No own-library production change.
